front.title: Discovery of AI Agents for Communication Services: Use Case and Problem Statement

abstract.t: This document presents a use case and problem statement for the initial discovery of AI agents supporting end-to-end communication services within an organization. The use case considers AI agents associated with different functions of the Internet protocol suite, including application, transport, Internet-layer, and related network-operation functions. These agents may share general capabilities but differ in their communication-related operational scopes and responsibilities. The document examines the minimum public discovery information needed to distinguish such agents within a known organizational discovery scope.
